verdict.rationale: Canva supports exporting individual designs in open, standard formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) via both the Connect API and the MCP server, giving users a way to pull their design content out in interoperable formats. However there is no evidence of a comprehensive account-level data export (brand kits, comments, team assets, settings, history) or a documented 'export all my data' / account deletion-and-portability feature that would let an AI-native user fully leave with everything intact. missing for 10: bulk/account-wide data export, documented data portability or GDPR-style export tool, evidence of exporting non-design data (comments, brand assets, admin/audit data) in open formats.
